note_en: Chunlan asks, 你是不是觉得我忘了这个家？ "You think I've forgotten this family, don't you?" Putting 是不是 before the predicate turns a statement into a question that expects the listener to confirm a guess, much like an English tag question ("..., don't you?" / "..., right?"). It sounds more pointed than simply adding 吗 at the end.
